Description.SourceString:
You would be forgiven for uttering the words “cute” at the sight of one of these baby dragons - a sentiment that lasts for the few picoseconds before they attempt to eat your face. Make no mistake, these are Kuldra’s broodlings, and they are filled with as much rage and hatred as she is. From the moment they hatch, these dragons are instilled with a violent need to destroy any that might breach Kuldra’s lair.

They may be cute, but you should cast aside that word in favour of a much better hyphenated one: self-preservation.
